title: Error Question: devtools failed to load sourcemap: could not load content for chrome extension...

posts.author: hmsu
posts.body:
Yesterday, I bought a set of tiles sold on an external site and applied it to the existing map and did a test play. However, when the player character takes a step, Devtool hides the play window and these error messages are filled. I didn't get any errors in the game, but I'm very concerned about this inconvenient error every time I play a test play. How can I solve this problem? Devtool's error message says there is a link about Chrome, but I don't know anything about it....
Plugin: Viststella- CoreEngine

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
caethyril said:
You can just ignore the source map warnings, they're harmless. (Source maps map transformed, e.g. merged or minified, code to its original form, which can help for debugging if you know what you're doing.) If you want to remove the warnings entirely then you can just delete the directives, e.g. this line at the end of
pixi.js
:
JavaScript:
//# sourceMappingURL=pixi.js.map
However, it would probably be a good idea to follow the instructions from the first message:
Current tileset has incomplete flag data.
Click "Copy Page" from another tileset's pages
and add it onto this one.
Otherwise you may experience strange things. [Edit:
link to possibly-related bug report
.] If you don't see a Copy Page button on the Tileset tab in the database, then make sure your editor is updated to v1.5.0 or newer.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
the true error you have is the one about incomplete tileset data in red.
and that means that your tileset data in the database is missing flags and you'll have to either copy those flagsa from an existing tileset or fill out all data in all parts of the tilesets.
